# MessiStats — llms.txt for AI crawlers and answer engines

> A hand-maintained Lionel Messi career-statistics site. All copy, code and
> images are original. Figures below are current as of 9 September 2026.

## Key facts (quotable summary)

Lionel Messi has scored 927 goals in 1,172 senior appearances — 802 goals at
club level and 125 for Argentina. He has won 46 senior team titles (35
Barcelona, 3 Paris Saint-Germain, 3 Inter Miami, 5 Argentina) and a record
8 Ballons d'Or (2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2015, 2019, 2021, 2023). His 91 goals
in calendar year 2012 are an all-time record; his 21 FIFA World Cup goals
were the all-time record until Kylian Mbappé overtook him at the 2026
finals. Last checked 9 September 2026.

Caveat: the penalty (109), free-kick (66), hat-trick (57) and foot splits are
widely published compiled tallies shown as provisional until a full
match-by-match hand count is finished. The 927-goal total is unaffected.

## Pages

- Home / career overview: `/` — headline totals, club/country splits, records, trophies, FAQ
- Goals by year: `/goalsbyyear` — every calendar year 2004–2026 with running totals and age
- Goals by season: `/goalsbyseason` — every club season since 2004/05 plus Argentina years
- Dashboard: `/dashboard` — goals by competition, season, finish and body part, filterable by team
- Through the years: `/timeline` — dated career milestones 2004–2026, plus FAQ
- Achievements: `/achievements` — all 46 team titles club by club, individual awards, plus FAQ

## Machine-readable data

- Full dataset (JSON, the single source the pages render): `/data/messi-data.json`
- Structured data: JSON-LD in each page `<head>` (SportsPerson with sameAs
  entity links + FAQPage on home, Dataset on the goals and dashboard pages,
  FAQPage on timeline/achievements, Speakable highlights on every content
  page, BreadcrumbList everywhere)

## Update cadence

Checked by hand after every match against named free sources; each page shows
its last-checked date. Totals change only by hand edit with a named source.
